title: FeasibleHessianGapComposite.lean

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize F=f+ψ over a convex feasible set Q; both f and ψ are convex on Q, and a minimizer exists.

problem_class.label: composite
problem_class.details: The objective combines differentiable f with a convex regularizer ψ accessible through exact proximal minimization over Q.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Returns ∇f(x) exactly for feasible queries x∈Q. No correctness is required outside Q; no function-value oracle is supplied.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: For a>0, returns an exact minimizer over Q of ‖u−z‖²/(2a)+⟨v,u−z⟩+ψ(u). Gradient and proximal queries consume the same fixed oracle budget.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: On Q, the derivative H of ∇f exists, is positive, and satisfies ‖H‖≤H0+H1(F(x)−F(xstar)). The controlling gap is the full composite objective gap. Public parameters satisfy H0,H1≥0 and R,Δ,ε>0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The ambient space is an arbitrary complete real inner-product space. Public x0∈Q has distance at most R from a hidden minimizer xstar and objective gap at most Δ. Neither the minimizer nor its objective value is supplied.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The returned point x must satisfy F(x)−F(xstar)≤ε for a minimizer xstar∈Q.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The returned point must belong to Q.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: Feasibility and the ε objective-gap bound hold almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law, within a fixed total oracle budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The composite feasible problem uses curvature controlled by the full objective gap only on the feasible set, with exact gradient and proximal access in a general Hilbert space. This differs from the standard globally Lipschitz-gradient composite formulation.

descriptionHtml:
Composite Minimization with Gap-Controlled Hessians

We consider minimizing F=f+ψ over a convex set Q in a real Hilbert space E, where f,ψ:E→R are convex on Q. At each feasible point, f has a positive semidefinite Hessian satisfying ∥∇2f(x)∥op≤H0+H1(F(x)−F(x⋆)), where H0,H1≥0 and x⋆∈Q minimizes F. A given x0∈Q satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R and F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ, with R,Δ>0. The oracle returns exact feasible gradients or exact proximal minimizers of ψ. For ε>0, the goal is x¯∈Q with F(x¯)−F(x⋆)≤ε almost surely.

The optimization problem is minx∈QF(x),F(x):=f(x)+ψ(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E, and ∥⋅∥op denotes the induced operator norm. The algorithm receives E, H0, H1, R, Δ, ε, and x0; the functions and feasible set are accessed through the oracle.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity). The set Q⊆E is convex. For every x,y∈Q and t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y),ψ((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)ψ(x)+tψ(y).

Assumption 2 (Minimizer and initialization). There exists x⋆∈Q such that x0∈Q and F(x⋆)≤F(x)for every x∈Q,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R,F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ.

Assumption 3 (Feasible Hessian bound). At every x∈Q, the function f is Fréchet differentiable, and its gradient is Fréchet differentiable at x as a map on E. The Hessian ∇2f(x):E→E is a bounded self-adjoint linear operator satisfying ⟨∇2f(x)h,h⟩≥0for every h∈E,∥∇2f(x)∥op≤H0+H1(F(x)−F(x⋆)). These derivatives are ambient derivatives, including at boundary points of Q.

Assumption 4 (Exact proximal access). There is a map P:R×E×E→E such that, for every a>0 and z,v∈E, P(a,z,v)∈argminu∈Q{∥u−z∥22a+⟨v,u−z⟩+ψ(u)}. In particular, these minimizers exist and the returned point is feasible.

The oracle supports two query types. For a gradient query at x∈Q, the oracle returns ∇f(x) at x. For a proximal query (a,z,v)∈R×E×E, it returns P(a,z,v), with the minimization property above applying when a>0. Both query types count toward one common oracle-call budget.

After the allotted calls, the output must satisfy x¯∈Q,F(x¯)−F(x⋆)≤εP-a.s., where P is the joint law of the algorithm’s and oracle’s randomness, which are independent.

comparisonHtml:
On a real Hilbert space, F=f+ψ with f,ψ convex on convex Q, exact gradients and exact Q-constrained regularizer prox. A minimizer x⋆∈Q exists, x0∈Q, ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R, and F(x0)−F(x⋆)≤Δ. On Q, ∇f is Fréchet differentiable with ∇2f(x)⪰0 and ∥∇2f(x)∥≤H0+H1(F(x)−F(x⋆)). Known H0,H1≥0 and R,Δ,ε>0. Target: feasible x^ with F(x^)−F(x⋆)≤ε deterministically.

import LongTails.Setups.CompositeGeneralizedSmooth
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Positive

open Set
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.FeasibleHessianGapComposite

open OracleTemplate

structure Params where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  H0 : ℝ
  H1 : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.linearE Params.completeE

abbrev oraclePublic (p : Params) : CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.Public where
  E := p.E
  L0 := p.H0
  L1 := p.H1
  R := p.R
  Δ := p.Δ
  x0 := p.x0

abbrev Instance (p : Params) := CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.Instance (oraclePublic p)
abbrev Query (p : Params) := CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.Query (oraclePublic p)

noncomputable def objective {p : Params} (I : Instance p) (x : p.E) : ℝ := I.f x + I.ψ x

structure Conditions (p : Params) (I : Instance p) (xstar : p.E) : Prop where
  convex_f : ConvexOn ℝ I.Q I.f
  gradient : ∀ x ∈ I.Q, HasGradientAt I.f (I.grad x) x
  convex_domain : Convex ℝ I.Q
  convex_regularizer : ConvexOn ℝ I.Q I.ψ
  prox : ∀ a, 0 < a → ∀ z v, I.prox a z v ∈ I.Q ∧
    IsMinOn (CompositeGeneralizedSmooth.proxObjective I a z v) I.Q (I.prox a z v)
  initial_feasible : p.x0 ∈ I.Q
  minimizer_feasible : xstar ∈ I.Q
  minimizer : IsMinOn (objective I) I.Q xstar
  distance : ‖p.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ p.R
  gap : objective I p.x0 - objective I xstar ≤ p.Δ
  hessian : ∀ x ∈ I.Q, ∃ H : p.E →L[ℝ] p.E,
    HasFDerivAt (_root_.gradient I.f) H x ∧ H.IsPositive ∧
      ‖H‖ ≤ p.H0 + p.H1 * (objective I x - objective I xstar)

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance := Instance
  Query := Query
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid p := 0 ≤ p.H0 ∧ 0 ≤ p.H1 ∧ 0 < p.R ∧ 0 < p.Δ ∧ 0 < p.ε
  admissible p I O :=
    (∀ k seed x, x ∈ I.Q → O.answer k (0, .gradient x) seed = I.grad x) ∧
    (∀ k seed a z v, O.answer k (0, .prox a z v) seed = I.prox a z v) ∧
    ∃ xstar, Conditions p I xstar
  successful p I output P :=
    ∃ xstar ∈ I.Q, IsMinOn (objective I) I.Q xstar ∧
      ∀ᵐ ω ∂(P : MeasureTheory.Measure _),
        output ω ∈ I.Q ∧ objective I (output ω) - objective I xstar ≤ p.ε

end LongTails.Setups.FeasibleHessianGapComposite
